nodes.title: Capability-by-identity not-found relocated into a service-level wrapper
nodes.summary: read-capability-by-identity's controller no longer performs its own held-check-and-throw; CapabilityRegistryService now offers a wrapper method it alone calls, while the raw readCapabilityByIdentity and every other consumer of it are unchanged.

nodes.title: Capability-by-identity not-found relocation into a service-level wrapper
nodes.summary: Proves the not-found refusal now originates from CapabilityRegistryService.readCapabilityByIdentityOrThrow rather than the controller, that the controller's handler is now a trivial pass-through, and that the raw readCapabilityByIdentity and test-connector's own refusal are unaffected.
